Table 1 Panel B frequencies are recorded as printed categories, not converted to binary means. Narrative means are recorded only where explicitly stated for the MEET1=1 subgroup.

The underlying estimator and standard-error correction for the Table 5 paired equations are not identified in the source; the separate likelihood-ratio comparison is not attached to individual coefficients.

Table 1 caption prints the impossible MEET3 period 1998–1993. The original Table 1 year distribution and Table 5 sample caption identify 1988–1993; the baseline MEET3 period follows Table 5 while the Table 1 caption discrepancy remains visible.

Table 2 reports means for PRICE, BVE, PVINCOME, and ACTPVINC in both meet-status subgroups for all three samples; all 24 mean cells are retained in six subgroup groups. Table 2 p-values are between-group mean-difference tests and are not individual baseline-fit inference.

Table 1 Panel B count, parenthetical distinct-firm count, and percent for both categories and the total are all retained. Percentages remain in source scale; no binary mean or derived proportion is calculated.
